summary: CriminalRecordsCheckEditAll provides a user interface for editing and maintaining criminal records check information for students, with a focus on batch editing and validation.
purpose: To allow authorized users (e.g., enrollment administrators) to review, update, and manage criminal records check status for cohorts of students. Supports validation, efficient data entry, and system feedback.

workflows.name: Batch CRC Edit
steps: User selects cohort, term, and course to filter students.
User reviews CRC status for each student in a grid.
User edits CRCStatusCode (dropdown), date, and notes for students.
If a change is made (row is 'dirty'), Save or Save All actions are enabled.
System validates input (e.g., date format, required fields).
User saves changes individually or in batch.
System updates records and provides feedback.
If Save All and Cancel buttons are hidden when grid has fewer than 14 rows (no scroll bars).

business_rules: CRCStatus must be selected for each student.
CRCStatusDate is required and must be valid.
Only authorized users can edit CRC.
validations: RegularExpressionValidator: Ensures CRCStatusDate is in expected format.
Grid disables edit fields in read-only mode.
Dirty flag on grid row tracks changes.
conditions: Edit mode is enabled only for authorized users and when appropriate filters are applied.
Grid disables edit fields if blnReadOnly is true.
system_behavior: Panel controls for Save, Cancel, navigation.
DataSource (dsCRC) populates grid based on cohort, term, course, and filter criteria.
exceptions: If UserSession is missing, DataSource select cancels.
content_gaps: Exact list of CRC status codes depends on Codes.CodeSearch data.
No explicit business rules for CRC expiration or advanced validation.
